0022600089.text: Both the Utah Jazz and Memphis Grizzlies open their 2026-27 seasons when the Jazz travel to face the Grizzlies. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot), and Blake Hinson (hamstring), Kyle Filipowski (back) and Trey Alexander (knee) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (out, ankle) and has GG Jackson (ankle), Jerami Grant (undisclosed soreness) and Micah Peavy (ankle) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Utah won the last meeting 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Jazz a 55% chance to win.
